## About
Sam's Auto Parts serves the Fridley area with quality used parts. We're a junkyard, so the parts come off vehicles in our yard, and our staff works to help you find what you need.
You can search our inventory on our website, search by image, or run a multi-part search. If you'd rather talk to someone, call and ask whether we have the part you're after.
We work with everyday drivers and with local repair shops. One auto shop that buys from us wrote that the owner is putting real effort into improving the business.

## Services
- Used auto parts: Quality used parts pulled from our yard.
- Inventory search: Search our inventory, search by image, or run a multi-part search.

## FAQ
Q: Can I call to check if you have a part?
A: Yes. Give us a call and ask about the part you need. One reviewer said a staff member went out and checked in person whether it was in stock.

Q: Are you open on Sunday?
A: No, we're closed on Sunday.

## What customers say

The owner is putting in real effort to improve the business and take things to the next level, and it shows. You can tell he actually cares about making things better for his customers.

On top of that, the staff there works hard. It’s not an easy job running a junkyard, but they stay grinding and do what they can to help you find what you need.

If you’re looking for a place that’s been around for years, knows the game, and is actively working to improve, I’d definitely recommend giving them a shot." (Taquitos Auto Repair, 5/5)
